title: Orange County Taiwanese Association 南加州 柑縣台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Orange County Taiwanese Association (橙縣台灣同鄉會, OCTA) is a regional chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization for Taiwanese American community associations. The chapter serves the Taiwanese American community in Orange County, California.
